scholarships.name: Example Valley STEM Scholarship

source_verification.evidence: The foundation's About page says it created and funds the STEM Scholarship.

amount.display: Up to $3,000 per year, renewable for four years with a 2.5 college GPA

requirements.evidence: For high school seniors entering college in fall 2027.
Applicants need a 3.0 GPA or must be first-generation college students.
Applicants need a 3.0 GPA or must be first-generation college students.

requirements.description: Plans to major in a STEM field
requirements.evidence: Recipients must pursue a degree in science, technology, engineering, or mathematics.

requirements.description: Preference for robotics or Science Olympiad participants
requirements.evidence: Preference is given to students active in robotics or Science Olympiad.

evidence.amount: Awards of up to $3,000 per year, renewable for four years with a 2.5 college GPA.
evidence.deadline: Applications must be received by March 1, 2027, 11:59 p.m. Eastern.
evidence.eligibility: Ohio high school seniors entering college in fall 2027 who will study STEM and have a 3.0 GPA or are first-generation college students.
evidence.application: Submit the online application, an essay, one teacher recommendation, and an unofficial transcript.

notes: No minimum GPA is published; the committee reviews essays and recommendations.
